It also ranks high across all domains:
#2 in Consumer Product
#3 in Brand & Marketing, Reference-based design, Gaming, and Content Creation Tools
#4 in Data & Analytics
#5 Simulations

Dig into the thread for more details and to see how it also performs on real-world tasks in the Text Arena.

Congrats to @Alibaba_Qwen on this huge release!
